findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header in index.html
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- index.html:4-15 -- no CSP meta tag present -->
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>EOH 2026 Contest Judging</title>
    <base href="/" />
    ...
</head>
findings.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy meta tag with directives appropriate for Blazor WASM: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:;

findings.title: Insecure random number generation using System.Random in PartitionService
findings.rule_violated: CWE-338 Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG
findings.remediation: Replace System.Random with System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator for partition shuffling, or use Random.Shared with explicit documentation that the randomness is non-cryptographic.

findings.title: Hardcoded SQLite connection strings
findings.rule_violated: Hardcoded configuration values should be externalized
findings.remediation: Move connection strings to appsettings.json or environment-specific configuration. Remove default parameter to force explicit configuration.

findings.title: Database backup in localStorage lacks integrity verification
findings.rule_violated: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
findings.remediation: Append an HMAC-SHA256 or CRC32 checksum to the backup payload before storing in localStorage. Verify on restore and reject if integrity check fails.

findings.title: Exception message exposed to browser console
findings.rule_violated: CWE-209 Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
findings.remediation: Use ILogger with appropriate log levels. Log generic messages in production; include exception details only in debug builds.

findings.title: Missing .db and .sqlite patterns in .gitignore
findings.evidence_snippet:
// .gitignore has *.dbmdl (line 244) but no *.db or *.sqlite pattern.
// The application creates contest.db as its SQLite database file.
findings.rule_violated: Database files containing contest data should not be committed to version control

findings.title: No authentication on administrative operations
findings.rule_violated: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
findings.remediation: Add a passphrase gate on the Setup page or implement token-based auth if server-side deployment is planned. Document the trusted-device deployment model if auth is intentionally omitted.

findings.title: Client-side SQLite — entire database accessible to browser user
findings.rule_violated: Blazor WASM runs entirely client-side; all data is accessible via browser DevTools
findings.remediation: Document the trust model in a SECURITY.md or README: this app is designed for a trusted judge's local device. If data confidentiality is needed, implement a backend API with server-side persistence.
